multipart-string.value: Dorinda is very good at the role of the perfect friend, she's a great listener and never fails to show her empathy. Connie, on the other hand, has always been the consummate showgirl and probably felt the need to embrace a more dramatic role. Also, let's face it, these were supposed to be the winning characters, not the forgotten ones.
